critic_pilot.definition: Pre-action archived root, rank=0 and policy=A only. Survival includes the first forced incumbent-greedy move. Softplus state value times 1000 yields placements, reward .001 and gamma 1. Grouped by root equally; repeat stream seeds identified. Historical disjoint cohort excludes previous control/diverse danger-pool seed union. A separate overlap check additionally excludes the current PPO danger-pool streams.
critic_pilot.scope: Frozen incumbent continuation on archived states, including repeated streams and historical evaluation/calibration sources; current policy may choose different moves. Capped observations give lower bounds only. No current or future fresh evaluation games entered.

largest_scalar.selection: Largest absolute FP64 difference over all first candidate linear weight and bias parameters; parameter name sorted lexically then flat C-order, lowest position wins an exact tie. Selection independent of the 40 observed action effects.

conditioned_game_pairs.inference: greedy FP32 CPU native exact two-stage, fixed 32 x 128, one CPU, standard physical commit
conditioned_game_pairs.sample: Six archived hazard-conditioned fit-side roots selected before PPO. Game stream matched within each pair. Capped placements are lower bounds. Outside formal model selection.

conditioned_game_pairs.inference: greedy FP32 CPU native exact two-stage, fixed 32 x 128, one CPU, standard physical commit
conditioned_game_pairs.sample: Six archived hazard-conditioned fit-side roots selected before PPO. Game stream matched within each pair. Capped placements are lower bounds. Outside formal model selection.

production_window.peak_memory_scope: Trainer-reported high water mark since runner initialization.

production_window_scope: Device-wide utilization and power; Linux process CPU covers the trainer. PPO allocator peaks cover the run to that point. Production update timestamps bound the matched window.
scope: One training seed of the plain recipe. Fixed-board actions, conditioned archived survival, and the frozen policy critic pilot are diagnostics. Official selection uses separate completed games starting empty.

checks: full candidate tuples ordered including score
all shared record arrays, teacher, prior and fallback
all padded invalid logits negative infinity, if any
dense fixed-shape choices and direct change counters
dense versus fast shortlist on this board

shared_direct_changed_action.scope: Training-archive greedy paths only. Stop search on the first action change; continue its original greedy path to verify the recorded terminal board within 120 seconds. Dense production CPU check at the flip; fixed FP32 forward shape 32×128.

shared_direct_cpu.fixture: Six prespecified archived training inputs across two seeds, covering shortlists of 1, 16, 36, 91 and 128. Full source game files, hashes, visible stream, landing/clears, final board and selected preaction board hashes verified by normal replay.
shared_direct_cpu.reference: Naive uses production evaluator select_moves independently for each loaded checkpoint. Shared prepares with W1 config once, forwards incumbent once, adds weight * (after-before) in FP32 and applies valid mask. Identical model state dictionaries and config except cross_weight verified.
shared_direct_cpu.scope: Repeated CPU evaluate/select hot path, three greedy players on identical frozen board, stream and target. Native production defaults. Includes proposal generation, teacher and mobility preparation, collation, fixed-batch FP32 forward, argmax, direct-change counters, candidate lookup. Excludes disk/model loading, replay, commits, scheduler, diverged boards, GPU and end-to-end gameplay.
